New mom Lady Gaga and fiance Michael Polansky enjoy outing in Bay Area... four months after welcoming daughter Rose

Lady Gaga stepped out with fiance Michael Polansky for a lowkey outing in the Bay Area to visit friends on Tuesday.

Actual Article Body:
By JACQUELINE LINDENBERG and JENNIFER PEARSON

Published:  07:05 AEDT, 14 October 2026   |  Updated:  07:09 AEDT, 14 October 2026

Lady Gaga stepped out with fiance Michael Polansky for a lowkey outing in the Bay Area to visit friends on Tuesday.

It comes just four months after the 40-year-old singer and the entrepreneur welcomed their first child together, a baby girl named Rose.

The pop star, who recently showed off her natural makeup routine, was stylishly casual wearing a floral maxi dress and a brown blazer that was draped over her shoulders.

Gaga slipped into a pair of tan-colored pumps and carried a black purse over her left shoulder.

The new mom pulled back her platinum blonde locks away from her face while also sporting a pair of fashionable shades.

The Bad Romance hitmaker could be seen holding a conversation on the phone while strolling under the warm sunshine.

Lady Gaga, 40, stepped out with fiance Michael Polansky for a lowkey outing in the Bay Area to visit friends on Tuesday, four months after welcoming daughter Rose

Polansky was also spotted as he sipped on an iced coffee while sporting a plain black shirt and gray shorts.

Daily Mail has reached out to reps of Gaga for comment, but has yet to hear back.

Four months earlier, Gaga and Polansky welcomed daughter Rose Bean Polansky via surrogate on June 9, per a birth certificate obtained by TMZ.

It was recently revealed that the music artist plans to give her daughter a 'normal childhood' despite her own fame.

Gaga and Polansky have been 'enjoying their little family bubble,' a source told Page Six.

'They've started taking Rose on little outings together, but for the most part, they're keeping things very private.'

After her Mayhem Ball tour ended in April, Gaga retreated from the public eye to an extremely private home in Marin County, California, to nest.

While she's built her massive career on her chameleon image and performance art, Gaga has reached a 'whole new level now that she's a mom,' the source revealed.

The superstar is 'fiercely protective of her daughter and very particular about who she allows into their inner circle and around the baby.

'She wants Rose to have as normal a childhood as possible, away from all the attention that comes with her fame.'

The insider continued: 'Gaga has always been such a strong, powerful woman, but becoming a mom has brought out this incredibly soft, emotional side of her.

'She's embracing every moment of it, and the people closest to her can see just how much this new chapter means to her.'

After working in the industry for two decades, her priorities have shifted and family comes first.

'She's loving the quieter moments at home and just getting to spend time with her daughter,' the source said, adding: 'Having this time to focus on her family has been incredibly special.'

Gaga began dating Polansky, the CEO of Parker Group, back in 2019.

The pair were first romantically linked when the two were seen celebrating New Year's in Las Vegas.

And in early 2020, the couple confirmed their budding romance by sharing a kiss in Miami and the Grammy winner went Instagram official with Polansky soon after.

Last year in October, Gaga opened up about her plans to be a mother in the near future during an interview on The Late Show With Stephen Colbert.

She expressed at the time that motherhood was her 'next starring role.'

'I would like to do many things. All of these things are open. But, what I really want is to be a mom. That's my next starring role, I hope,' Gaga said.

The songstress also spoke about her wishes for her future children, telling Elle: 'Family - it's like the roots of the tree. They grow long, and sometimes they're mangled, and sometimes they're full of water, and sometimes they're thirsty.

'Family is what makes you who you are, and it also defines your need for change.

'Maybe other than that, I just did my best. And tried to stay true to myself along the way. That's something Michael and I have talked about a lot - allowing our kids to be their own people,' Gaga expressed; the couple seen in 2024 in Venice

'I would want my children to understand that whatever my artistry means to them is totally up to them. I would never actually want to shape it or tell them how to think about me.

'Maybe other than that, I just did my best. And tried to stay true to myself along the way. That's something Michael and I have talked about a lot - allowing our kids to be their own people...'

Last month in September, Gaga was pictured with her baby arriving in Los Angeles after news broke that she and the entrepreneur had welcomed their first child.

At the time, the Born This Way hitmaker was carrying her baby in a light-colored sling.
